scenario_description:
Objective: Keep the upcoming showcase tasting station from being excluded at allergen gate because its tent card omits a major nut ingredient.
Emerging Need: The showcase and formula assignment alone do not show a mismatch; the need arises when the previewed card conflicts with the stored approved formula while export is still open.
Decision Context: Stored formula and allergen-card rules identify the ingredient risk, the verified correction route, safe disclosures, and why sealed cards cannot be repaired for panel table access.
Consequence: Timely correction can preserve safe, usable tasting evidence; after board export, the future station check will use the deficient sealed card.
